module_summary: Serial UART-style byte receiver: a 12-state FSM tracks start/data/stop bits while a 10-bit shift register captures the byte.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Sequences START, B0-B7, STOP, DONE and ERR recovery; drives done.

anchors.name: byte_r
anchors.why: Shift register sampling in every cycle; bits 8:1 hold the received byte.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse in DONE state qualifying out_byte.

anchors.name: out_byte
anchors.why: Received data byte from byte_r, valid when done.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Serial bit stream; feeds both shift register and framing FSM.

groups.name: framing_fsm
groups.description: Detects start bit, counts 8 data bits, verifies stop bit, waits on error.

groups.name: rx_shifter
groups.description: LSB-first deserializer; out_byte gated by done.
